caption: The drawing depicts an urban street scene with a central focus on a tall tree with a slender brown trunk and green foliage, standing in a small rectangular concrete planter. The tree is surrounded by a black metal fence. To the right, there is a multi-story building with tan walls, blue window shutters, and an awning extending over the sidewalk; multiple doors and windows face the street. In the background to the left, there are additional multi-story buildings painted in light yellow and beige, featuring various sized windows and some purple and orange details on the awnings and accents. The sky appears to be a light beige such as the color of the paper rather than a painted background. The overall composition is rendered in soft, muted colors, primarily browns, greens, yellows, and grays, with gentle shading suggesting depth.
title: Street Scene
